wire.process_cost: regenerate_graph_layout.py is PRESERVE-COORDS by default: it reuses every prior (x, y) keyed by canonical id and embeds only NEW nodes; --fresh re-embeds everything. A relayout therefore ships as a one-off rewrite of globalGraphLayout.json coordinates (which later runs then preserve) followed by regenerate:neural; globalGraphLayout.json itself is an emitter input, not a fetched payload.
